dedupe_keys.name: response and fragility modeling of aging bridges subjected to earthquakes and truck loads

description: Response and Fragility Modeling of Aging Bridges Subjected to Earthquakes and Truck Loads is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Jamie Padgett, Rice University (rice.edu). This project performs simulations to study the seismic response of seven different bridge classes. The contributions of this project are: 1) the finite element models are parameterized to facilitate regional level probabilistic seismic performance assessment; and 2) they allow inclusion of deterioration due to aging and environmental exposure when assessing seismic behavior. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-5tzv-qz91. Keywords: Opensees, Bridge classes, parameterized fragilities, seismic response. Published 2019-05-29. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
